note: Synthetic questions over the demo Case Files TB-001 to TB-008; a measurement, not a pass mark; no accuracy claim. Written for a clinician to review. Every expected quote is checked word for word against the page text by check_agent_live_gold.py. Question kinds: answerable, cross, not_documented, out_of_scope, guideline, follow_up (a follow_up names the answerable question it follows in 'follows' and only makes sense after it). 'category_alt' lists other refusal categories that also count as a correct refusal. 'status_ok' lists the statuses that are acceptable for a guideline question. 'colleague_style' marks a request worded the way one asks a colleague.
